entities.summary: Higgins, a notable figure in the history of Chile, associated with Independence and the O'Higgins Republic (1810–1823). Preceded by Spanish Reconquista and First National Junta — September 18, 1810 (Chilean National Day). Their legacy influenced Battle of Chacabuco — O'Higgins and San Martín liberate Chile, February 12, 1817 and Formal independence declared — February 12, 1818.
